#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

TARGET_DIR="${1:-/tmp/backup}"
mkdir -p "${TARGET_DIR}"
for file in *.log; do
    [[ -f "$file" ]] || continue
    gzip -c "$file" > "${TARGET_DIR}/${file}.gz"
done
echo "Backup complete."

find . -type f -name "*.py" -exec grep -Hn "TODO" {} \;

SELECT u.id, u.username, COUNT(o.id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_spent
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
WHERE u.status = 'active' AND o.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY u.id, u.username
HAVING SUM(o.amount) > 500
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 20;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS typing_sessions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    mode TEXT NOT NULL,
    wpm REAL NOT NULL,
    raw_wpm REAL NOT NULL,
    accuracy REAL NOT NULL,
    duration REAL NOT NULL
);
